_note: Out-of-sample robustness for Section 6.1. Every fit uses the paper's multi-start protocol; regimes are labelled by sigma2 ascending, so ratio = tau_calm / tau_stressed and a value below unity means the stressed regime is the more persistent one.
_verdicts: The side of unity of the ratio is the Wald test of phi_calm = phi_stressed under each covariance, inference.<cov>.ratio_wald: the ratio is one exactly when the two coefficients are equal, so the test needs no delta step. Where p_cc + p_ss - 1 is significantly positive the switching-adjusted ratio lies on the same side of unity, inference.<cov>.ratio_switching_side. The linear, log-scale and Fieller sets in inference.<cov>.ratio_ci95, the delta intervals of the switching-adjusted ratio and its simulated interval (ratio_switching_sim) are descriptive. Each record's top-level ci95 and significance are the Hessian linear delta interval and its side, the columns of table8_rolling and table9_sensitivity.
